fee_notes: Single Grill and Pub: $39,500; single Wings Etc. 2Go: $20,000. Development Agreement franchisees pay the standard fee for the first restaurant, then reduced fees for 2nd and subsequent restaurants ranging from $22,500–$31,000 (Grill and Pub) and $15,000–$16,750 (Wings Etc. 2Go) depending on total development area size. A separate nonrefundable Development Fee ($30,000–$100,000 for Grill and Pub; $15,000–$50,000 for Wings Etc. 2Go) is also due, with a prorated credit applied against subsequent Initial Franchise Fees. Honorably discharged veterans receive a 20% discount on the applicable Initial Franchise Fee. All fees are lump sum, fully earned upon receipt, and non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: For a Grill and Pub, you pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $39,500 when you sign a Franchise Agreement. For a Wings Etc. 2Go, you pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $20,000 when you sign a Franchise Agreement.
